page: Amazon Web Services m8id.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. The CPU includes 480 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage, the m8id.16xlarge includes 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. It does not feature any GPUs. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 30 Gbps, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and memory performance. The instance achieved top-tier results in Geekbench single-core, multi-core, software compilation, image processing, and text processing tests. It also demonstrated top-tier performance in static web serving throughput and prompt processing for medium and large LLM models. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations scored in the strong category, while single-core stress-ng performance and large-block memory writes fell into the average category.

The inclusion of high-speed DDR5 memory and local NVMe SSD storage offers a balanced resource density for data-intensive workloads. The hardware profile is suited for database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM prompt processing.
